catalogCompleteness.name: CatalogCompleteness
catalogCompleteness.definition: present required STRUCTURED attributes / applicable required structured attributes; one unit per SKU x category requirement. Text in the description never counts.

semanticCoverage.name: SemanticCoverage
semanticCoverage.definition: required attributes present structurally OR supported by explicit text evidence / applicable required attributes; one unit per SKU x category requirement. Text evidence counts only when the asserted value equals the authoritative clean-store value, so a misleading description can never raise coverage.

dataConsistency.name: DataConsistency
dataConsistency.definition: passed applicable consistency checks / applicable consistency checks. Checks: catalog stockStatus vs Inventory (per SKU), catalog listedPrice vs Pricing (per SKU), catalog Istanbul delivery promise vs Shipping calculation (per SKU with a promise and authoritative stock), description claim vs authoritative attribute (per claim), variant relationship (per variant of a multi-variant category), return-policy cell explicit and authoritative (per cell).
